title: Pure normalized sections lie in the evaluated comparison range.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U,W$ objects of its small etale site, $g:W\to U$ a morphism, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Let $f$ be an additive homomorphism from degree $n$ of the singleton Amitsur complex to degree $n$ of the singleton tensor-section Cech complex satisfying [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Put $P=W\times_U\cdots\times_U W$ with $n+1$ factors and let $q$ evaluate the target at its unique outer index, followed by $\mathrm{ULift.down}$. Every section $(\prod_k\pi_k^*b_k)\rho(m)$ belongs to the range of $q\circ f$, where $m\in\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$, $b_k\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$ and $\rho$ is the normalized restriction to $P$. No affineness hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor calculation; explicit pure-tensor normalization

proof.text: For the generator attached to m and b, take ULift.up(m tensor tprod(b)) in the source degree. The normalization equation identifies its image under evaluation after f with the desired section. This supplies the witness of range membership for every generator.

lean.statement:
theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom_normalized_range
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f) :
    let P := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)
    let N := Γ((Modules.tensorPullback P.left.hom).obj F, ⊤)
    let D : (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 1) → AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      fun _ ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} N)
    let q : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n →+ N :=
      (AddEquiv.ulift : ULift.{u + 1} N ≃+ N).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (Pi.π D (fun _ ↦ 0)).hom
    Set.range (fun p : Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤) ×
      (Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)) ↦
        (∏ k : Fin (n + 1),
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g) k).left.left.appTop (p.2 k)) •
            Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F P.hom p.1) ⊆
      (q.comp f.hom).range
